```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)

nodes <- read_csv("../network/nodes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
edges <- read_csv("../network/edges.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Verificar nós duplicados
nodes %>%
  dplyr::count(name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

# Verificar arestas com nós inexistentes
setdiff(
  unique(c(edges$Source, edges$Target)),
  nodes$name
)

# Verificar tipos e camadas
table(nodes$type, nodes$layer)

# Contar NAs
colSums(is.na(edges))

colSums(is.na(nodes))


# Visualizar as linhas com NA
edges %>%
  filter(is.na(Source) | is.na(Target))

nodes %>%
  filter(is.na(name))
```

```{r}
edges <- edges %>%
  filter(!is.na(Source), !is.na(Target))

nodes <- nodes %>%
  filter(!is.na(name))

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges,
  vertices = nodes %>% rename(name = name),
  directed = FALSE
)

# Remover loops e arestas duplicadas
g <- simplify(
  g,
  remove.multiple = TRUE,
  remove.loops = TRUE
)

vcount(g)
ecount(g)

table(V(g)$type, V(g)$layer)

components(g)$no
```

```{r}
comp <- components(g)

# Tamanho de cada componente
comp$csize

# Distribuição dos tipos de nós por componente
table(
  Component = comp$membership,
  Type = V(g)$type
)

# Listar os nós que não pertencem ao maior componente

V(g)$name[comp$membership != main_comp]
```

```{r}
library(mclust)
set.seed(123)
seeds <- sample.int(100000, 30)

partitions_B <- lapply(seeds, function(s) {
  set.seed(s)

  membership(cluster_leiden(
    g_leiden_B,
    objective_function = "modularity",
    resolution = 1,
    n_iterations = 10,
    weights = NA
  ))
})

ari_matrix_B <- outer(
  seq_along(partitions_B),
  seq_along(partitions_B),
  Vectorize(function(i, j) {
    adjustedRandIndex(
      partitions_B[[i]],
      partitions_B[[j]]
    )
  })
)

summary(ari_matrix_B[upper.tri(ari_matrix_B)])

# Frequência do número de comunidades
table(sapply(partitions_B, function(x) {
  length(unique(x))
}))
```

```{r}
library(purrr)

resolutions <- c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2)

results <- map_dfr(resolutions, function(res) {

  partitions <- lapply(seeds, function(s) {
    set.seed(s)

    membership(cluster_leiden(
      g_leiden_B,
      objective_function = "modularity",
      resolution = res,
      n_iterations = 10,
      weights = NA
    ))
  })

  # Modularidade convencional
  mods <- sapply(partitions, function(p) {
    modularity(g_leiden_B, p, weights = NA)
  })

  # Número de comunidades
  n_communities <- sapply(partitions, function(p) {
    length(unique(p))
  })

  # ARI entre todos os pares
  pairs <- combn(seq_along(partitions), 2)

  ari <- apply(pairs, 2, function(idx) {
    adjustedRandIndex(
      partitions[[idx[1]]],
      partitions[[idx[2]]]
    )
  })

  tibble(
    resolution = res,
    modularity_mean = mean(mods),
    modularity_sd = sd(mods),
    ari_mean = mean(ari),
    ari_median = median(ari),
    communities_mean = mean(n_communities),
    communities_min = min(n_communities),
    communities_max = max(n_communities)
  )
})

print(results, width = Inf)
```
```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = resolution, y = modularity_mean)) +
```

```{r}
# ARI médio de cada partição em relação às demais

# Partição mais representativa

representative_B <- partitions_B[[best_idx]]

# Semente correspondente
```

```{R}
community_stability <- lapply(
  sort(unique(representative_B)),
  function(comm) {

    original_nodes <- which(representative_B == comm)

    jaccard <- sapply(partitions_B[-best_idx], function(p) {

      max(sapply(unique(p), function(c) {

        other_nodes <- which(p == c)

        length(intersect(original_nodes, other_nodes)) /
          length(union(original_nodes, other_nodes))

      }))
    })

    data.frame(
      Community = comm,
      Size = length(original_nodes),
      Jaccard_mean = mean(jaccard),
      Jaccard_median = median(jaccard),
      Jaccard_min = min(jaccard),
      Jaccard_sd = sd(jaccard)
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

community_stability
# c1 c2 e c4 para interpretacao biologica
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mimedb <- read_csv("mimedb.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
classyfire <- read_csv("classyfire.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

mets_merged <- mimedb |>
  left_join(classyfire, by = "InChIKey",
            na_matches = "never",
            suffix = c("_mimedb", "_classyfire"))

mets_merged <- mets_merged |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    Classification = {
      x <- str_trim(c_across(c(MiMeDB_classification, Kingdom:`Parent Level 4`)))
      paste(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""], collapse = "; ")
    }
  ) |>
  ungroup()

mets_merged <- mets_merged |>
  mutate(
    Classification = map_chr(Classification, function(x) {
      if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)

      x <- str_split(x, ";")[[1]]
      x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(x))
      x <- unique(x[x != ""])

      paste(x, collapse = "; ")
    })
  )

mets_classified <- mets_merged |>
  select(CID, Name, InChIKey, Classification) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r}
class_frequency <- mets_classified |>
  separate_rows(Classification, sep = ";") |>
  mutate(Classification = str_trim(Classification)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Classification), Classification != "") |>
  group_by(Classification) |>
  summarise(
    n_metabolites = n_distinct(CID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_metabolites))

class_frequency |>
  slice_max(n_metabolites, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(Classification, n_metabolites),
    y = n_metabolites
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Metabolite classification",
    y = "Number of metabolites"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

eligible_classes <- class_frequency |>
  filter(
    n_metabolites >= 3,
    Classification != "Unclassified"
  ) |>
  pull(Classification)

metabolite_classes_filtered <- mets_classified |>
  separate_rows(Classification, sep = ";") |>
  mutate(Classification = str_trim(Classification)) |>
  filter(Classification %in% eligible_classes) |>
  distinct()
```

```{R}
universe <- metabolite_classes |>
  distinct(CID, community)

enrichment <- expand_grid(
  community = sort(unique(universe$community)),
  Classification = eligible_classes
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    class_members = list(
      unique(metabolite_classes$CID[
        metabolite_classes$Classification == Classification
      ])
    ),

    a = sum(universe$community == community &
              universe$CID %in% class_members),
    b = sum(universe$community == community) - a,
    c = length(class_members) - a,
    d = nrow(universe) - a - b - c,

    expected = (a + b) * (a + c) / nrow(universe),
    fold_enrichment = a / expected,

    p_value = fisher.test(
      matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      alternative = "greater"
    )$p.value
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-class_members) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj, p_value)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

enrichment_sig <- enrichment |>
  filter(p_adj < 0.01)

plot_communities <- ggplot(
                      enrichment_sig,
                      aes(
                        x = factor(community, levels = sort(unique(universe$community))),
                        y = Classification,
                        size = fold_enrichment,
                        color = -log10(p_adj)
                      )
                    ) +
                      geom_point() +
                      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
                      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
                      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) +
                      labs(
                        x = "Community",
                        y = "Chemical classification",
                        size = "Fold enrichment",
                        color = expression(-log[10](FDR))
                      ) +
                      theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
                      theme(
                        axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
                        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
                        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
                        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
                        plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
                        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
                        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85",
                                                          linewidth = 0.5),
                        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
                        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(
  "communities.png",
  plot = plot_communities,
  width = 14,

  units = "in",

)
```

```{r}
  Leiden = sort(unique(representative_B)),
  Louvain = sort(unique(representative_louvain))
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    nodes_leiden = list(which(representative_B == Leiden)),
    nodes_louvain = list(which(representative_louvain == Louvain)),

    Jaccard = length(intersect(nodes_leiden, nodes_louvain)) /

  ungroup() |>
  select(-nodes_leiden, -nodes_louvain)
```

# Subnetworks

```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)

g_c1 <- induced_subgraph(
  g_leiden_B,
  vids = V(g_leiden_B)[community == 1 & type != "Species"]
)

g_c4 <- induced_subgraph(
  g_leiden_B,
  vids = V(g_leiden_B)[community == 4 & type != "Species"]
)

plot_network <- function(g, g_layout) {
  set.seed(123)

  ggraph(g, layout = g_layout) +
    geom_edge_link(
      alpha = 0.15,
      colour = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      aes(colour = type, shape = type),
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(type == "Gene", name, "")),
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "Gene" = "#D95F02",
      "Metabolite" = "#1B9E77"
    )) +
    theme_graph()
}
```

```{r}
met_gene_edges <- as_data_frame(g_leiden_B, what = "edges") |>
  transmute(
    CID = if_else(from %in% gene_communities$name, to, from),
    Gene = if_else(from %in% gene_communities$name, from, to)
  ) |>
  filter(
    Gene %in% gene_communities$name,
    CID %in% universe$CID
  ) |>
  distinct()

heatmap_classes <- metabolite_classes |>
  mutate(community = as.integer(community)) |>
  inner_join(
    enrichment_sig |>
      mutate(community = as.integer(community)) |>
      filter(community %in% c(1, 4)) |>
      select(community, Classification),
    by = c("community", "Classification")
  ) |>
  distinct(CID, community, Classification)

class_totals <- heatmap_classes |>
  group_by(community, Classification) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n_distinct(CID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

heatmap_data <- heatmap_classes |>
  inner_join(met_gene_edges, by = "CID",
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  group_by(community, Classification, Gene) |>
  summarise(
    n_interacting = n_distinct(CID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  complete(
    nesting(community, Classification),
    Gene = gene_communities$name,
    fill = list(n_interacting = 0)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    class_totals,
    by = c("community", "Classification")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n_interacting / n_total
  )

plot_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_data,
  aes(x = Gene, y = Classification, fill = percentage)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(
    community ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    name = "Interacting\nmetabolites (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Molecular target",
    y = "Chemical classification"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "heatmap_communities.pdf",
  plot = plot_heatmap,
  width = 16,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

write_csv(heatmap_data, "heatmap_data.csv")
```

```{r}
community_totals <- universe |>

gene_preference <- universe |>

gene_difference <- gene_preference |>
  select(Gene, community, percentage) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = community,
    values_from = percentage,
    names_prefix = "C"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = C1 - C4,
    preference = case_when(
      difference > 0 ~ "Community 1",
      difference < 0 ~ "Community 4",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(difference))

print(gene_difference, n = Inf)

plot_difference <- ggplot(
  gene_difference,
  aes(
    x = difference,
    y = reorder(Gene, difference),
    fill = preference
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Community 1" = "#0072B2",
    "Community 4" = "#D55E00",
    "No difference" = "grey70"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-90, 90),
    breaks = seq(-90, 90, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in interacting metabolites (percentage points)",
    y = "Molecular target",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-10, 10),
  colour = "grey70",
  linetype = "dashed",
  linewidth = 0.5) 

ggsave(
  "gene_preference.png",
  plot_difference,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)

write_csv(gene_difference, "gene_difference.csv")
```

```{r}
filter_network <- function(g, comm, genes) {

  g_sub <- induced_subgraph(
    g,
    vids = V(g)[
      (community == comm & type == "Metabolite") |
      (type == "Gene" & name %in% genes)
    ]
  )

  # Remover nós sem interações
  g_sub <- delete_vertices(
    g_sub,
    V(g_sub)[degree(g_sub) == 0]
  )

  g_sub
}

g_c1_top <- filter_network(g_leiden_B, 1, top_c1)
g_c4_top <- filter_network(g_leiden_B, 4, top_c4)
```

```{r}
node_classes <- metabolite_classes |>
  mutate(community = as.integer(community)) |>
  inner_join(
    enrichment_sig |>
      mutate(community = as.integer(community)) |>
      select(community, Classification, p_adj),
    by = c("community", "Classification")
  ) |>
  group_by(CID, community) |>
  slice_min(p_adj, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

add_classes <- function(g) {
  V(g)$chemical_class <- node_classes$Classification[
    match(V(g)$name, node_classes$CID)
  ]

  V(g)$chemical_class <- case_when(
    V(g)$type == "Gene" ~ "Molecular target",
    is.na(V(g)$chemical_class) ~ "Other metabolites",
    TRUE ~ V(g)$chemical_class
  )

  g
}
g_c1_top <- add_classes(g_c1_top)
g_c4_top <- add_classes(g_c4_top)

plot_c1_top <- plot_network_top(g_c1_top, "Community 1")
plot_c4_top <- plot_network_top(g_c4_top, "Community 4")
```

```{r}
palette <- c(
  "Amino acids and derivatives" = "#0072B2",
  "Flavonoids" = "#D55E00",
  "Molecular target" = "#222222",
  "Other metabolites" = "#CCCCCC"
)

plot_network_top <- function(g, title) {

  coords <- concentric_layout(g)

  set.seed(123)

  ggraph(g, layout = "manual", 
         x = coords$x, y = coords$y) +
    geom_edge_link(
      alpha = 0.15,
      colour = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      aes(colour = chemical_class, shape = type),
      size = 5
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(
        label = name,
        fontface = ifelse(type == "Gene", "bold", "plain")
      ),
      family = "sans",
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 5,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Gene" = 17, "Metabolite" = 16)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      colour = "Chemical classification",
      shape = "Node type"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_graph(base_family = "sans",
                base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "vertical",
          legend.box.just = "center")
}
```

```{r}
selected_metabolites <- metabolite_classes |>
  mutate(community = as.integer(community)) |>
  filter(
    (community == 1 & Classification == "amino acids and derivatives") |
    (community == 4 & Classification == "flavonoids")
  ) |>
  distinct(CID, community, Classification)

filter_chemical <- function(g, comm) {

  cids <- selected_metabolites |>
    filter(community == comm) |>
    pull(CID)

  g_sub <- induced_subgraph(
    g,
    vids = V(g)[type == "Gene" | name %in% cids]
  )

  g_sub <- delete_vertices(
    g_sub,
    V(g_sub)[degree(g_sub) == 0]
  )

  g_sub
}

g_c1_chemical <- filter_chemical(g_c1_top, 1)
g_c4_chemical <- filter_chemical(g_c4_top, 4)

V(g_c1_chemical)$chemical_class <- ifelse(
  V(g_c1_chemical)$type == "Gene",
  "Molecular target",
  "Amino acids and derivatives"
)

V(g_c4_chemical)$chemical_class <- ifelse(
  V(g_c4_chemical)$type == "Gene",
  "Molecular target",
  "Flavonoids"
)

concentric_layout <- function(g) {

  nodes <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "vertices") |>
    group_by(type) |>
    mutate(
      angle = 2 * pi * (row_number() - 1) / n(),
      radius = if_else(type == "Gene", 0.4, 1),
      x = radius * cos(angle),
      y = radius * sin(angle)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  nodes
}

plot_c1_chem <- plot_network_top(g_c1_chemical, "Community 1")
plot_c4_chem <- plot_network_top(g_c4_chemical, "Community 4")
```
